syllabusTopics: Relation between the angle of prism, minimum deviation and refractive index
agentNotes: Authoring contract: frontend/AGENTS.md §9 (extra unit card). Exam bank: symmetric-passage MCQ (2023), 60-degree/1.5 numerical (2022).

card.title: Exam bank — every board question on prisms

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Two questions: deviation is minimum only for symmetric passage (2023 MCQ) and the A = 60 degrees, mu = 1.5 numerical (2022: delta-m ~37.2 degrees). At minimum i = e and r = A/2, unlocking mu = sin[(A+dm)/2]/sin(A/2).

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: delta = i + e - A (A = r1 + r2) · minimum: mu = sin[(A+dm)/2]/sin(A/2), i = e, r = A/2 · small-angle: delta = (mu - 1) A

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: The mu formula holds ONLY at minimum deviation (meaning symmetric passage, single wavelength). MCQ logic: symmetry is the condition, not a property — deviation is not always minimum. Small-angle form needs A under ~10 degrees.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: A = 60, mu = 1.5: sin[(60+dm)/2] = 0.75 gives dm ~ 37.2 degrees. Equilateral with dm = 60 gives mu = sqrt(3). Immersed prisms rescale to relative index.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2022 (4): with i = 40 degrees given, work internal angles (r1 from Snell, r2 = A - r1), emerge, sum delta = i + e - A. NEB 2023 (1): deviation minimum only when the ray passes symmetrically — option (a).

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: mu formula used off-minimum; white-light smear ignored; thick-prism displacement missed. Surface flaws break symmetry assumptions.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: d delta/di = 0 forces the reversible symmetric path (Fermat); then r = A/2 and Snell gives the mu formula. Small-angle follows from sin x ~ x linearisation.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: 'Minimum deviation' means write i = e, r = A/2 instantly. 60-degree prism with dm 60 means mu root-3 on sight.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2023 (1): symmetric-passage MCQ. NEB 2022 (4): 60-degree/1.5 prism numerical. That is the complete bank.
